summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called empagliflozin to see how it affects non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, a disease marked by fat buildup and inflammation in the liver. Adults aged 18 to 75 with this liver condition will take the study drug daily for 12 months. Military University Hospital, Prague is organizing this study for 30 participants. The status is Enrolling by invitation, and it has No phase.
